title: Safety of Multimodal Large Language Models on Images and Texts

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying evaluation benchmarks like GOAT-Bench that measure the model's capability to recognize misogyny in meme-based multimodal inputs, which is treated as a classification task and evaluated using rule-based metrics like F1 score and accuracy.

Reviewing comprehensive safety benchmarks that categorize 'Unfairness and Discrimination' as core safety evaluation scenarios. These are assessed using a combination of human evaluation, rule-based text matching, and model-based automatic evaluation (e.g., using GPT-4 or specific classifiers like Perspective API).

Analyzing datasets (e.g., GOAT-Bench, ToViLaG) that test for hateful, offensive, and abusive content in multimodal contexts, using machine learning models (Perspective API, Detoxify) and classification performance metrics (AUROC, accuracy) to quantify the generation or recognition of hate speech.
